messages:
maria: first-call weirdness — quickstart CLI prints 'first call success' but the sample app's /v1/generate gets a 302 redirect to /billing/checkout. Signed up via invite link, no card on file. anyone seen a redirect like this? :confused:

ash: can you paste the curl -v output? curious about the headers and the Location response.

maria: here ya go (repro on mac):
```
$ curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-test-xxx' https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate
> GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood-inference.example
> User-Agent: curl/7.68.0
> Accept: */*
> Authorization: Bearer sk-test-xxx

< HTTP/1.1 302 Found
< Location: https://console.redwood-inference.example/billing/checkout?reason=firstcall
< Set-Cookie: session=...; Path=/; HttpOnly

```
maria: note that the CLI printed a 200 earlier when I ran `redwood quickstart init` locally, so token flow seems ok. the programmatic client request gets redirected.

jon: ok that looks like our web UI routing intercepting the 402/billing state and doing an HTML redirect. we historically redirect browsers to Stripe. that should be gated on Accept header or content negotiation. the API should return a machine-readable 402 JSON for api clients.

lena: interesting — the sample node app uses `node-fetch` and doesn't set `Accept: application/json` explicitly. many clients send `Accept: */*` which our web layer might treat as accepting HTML.

ash: SDKs used to set `Accept: application/json` by default, but quickstart templates have a tiny fetch snippet that relies on defaults. two issues: 1) server-side logic treating `*/*` as html-preferring, 2) our SDK/quickstart not explicitly requesting JSON.

maria: temporary workaround for anyone blocked: add `-H 'Accept: application/json'` to curl or set `fetch(..., { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } })` in the sample app. also `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest` works.

jon: long-term fix: API should not 302 for programmatic flows. propose: if `Accept` contains `application/json` OR `X-Requested-With` header present, respond with HTTP 402 + JSON body: { "error": { "code": "billing_required", "message": "Add billing to complete first call" } } and avoid setting Location. also update SDKs to set Accept and handle 402.

ash: noted. filing ENG ticket INF-4727 and a quick canary patch to change content-negotiation behavior on the gateway. will also update quickstart templates to include explicit Accept header.

maria: thanks — also saw the SDK retry wrapper was retrying on non-GET 302s in one sample, which could create duplicate non-idempotent behaviour. can we ensure retries treat 3xx as terminal for POST/streaming endpoints?

jon: good catch. adding retry rule change to INF-4727.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to devex with patch INF-4727-canary at 3512346802 :rocket:

maria: confirmed quickstart node sample now gets 402 JSON instead of 302 when I set Accept: application/json, and the README update + note about adding header fixed our internal CI tests. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

lena: i'll send a PR to the quickstart repo to explicitly set Accept and add a one-liner explaining the billing-gate 402 -> link to INF-4727.

maria: leaving this thread; will reopen if the canary reveals anything.
